description: Fade-in of every shown layer surface (a non-normative display behaviour; spec 0.1 does not define a fade). Opacity is clamp(elapsedSeconds / durationSeconds, 0, 1) with a linear curve; elapsed time counts from the moment the surface is shown (tracking start for images and effects, first frame ready for video). Losing the target hides at once without a fade-out. Only the first find after the work loads fades; a later find shows at once at opacity 1 (video still waits for its first frame). Expected values are computed by hand.
